result:
I've set all 32 DG2 rows in `docs/delivery/requirements.csv` to IMPLEMENTED with evidence, and `node tools/gates/validate.mjs --register DG2` now passes. Six open round-1 findings still affect some of these rows, so the status alone does not mean they work end to end.

**What changed:** only the `status`, `evidence` and `notes` columns of those 32 rows; `git diff` shows exactly 32 lines removed and 32 added. Every evidence path was checked to exist at base `96f736c`. The evidence points to:
- the P2 migrations (0010–0018), API modules and screens;
- the tests that verify each row, including integration, unit, web and the `apps/web/e2e/p2-journeys.spec.ts` browser tests;
- the API contract, ERD and ADR-0015…0020;
- the implementer handbacks and the existing test logs (414 integration tests passed; 38 browser tests passed).

Before citing a test, I matched its name against the row's acceptance clause.

**Checks I ran:**
- `node tools/gates/validate.mjs --register DG2` → `PASS register rules at DG2`, exit 0.
- `node tools/gates/validate.mjs --historical --stage DG1` → `PASS gate DG1 (historical)`, exit 0.
- The CSV still parses: 412 rows, 19 columns each, no broken quoting. Status counts: DG0 19, DG1 12 and DG2 32 IMPLEMENTED; every later-gate row is still SPECIFIED.
- I did not re-run the application tests; the register cites the existing logs.

**Gaps the register can't fix** (each is named in the row's notes and in the handback):
- **F-DG2-201 (High):** at this base, G2 can never be completed through normal use, because no path sets a KPI definition to active. This affects REQ-PB-017, REQ-S04-004 and REQ-DLV-034. No browser test gets past G1. These rows depend on the repair in task T-DG2-KBE2; **if it isn't merged and verified, REQ-S04-004 and REQ-DLV-034 should go back to SPECIFIED.**
- **Other open findings:**
  - F-DG2-140 and F-DG2-141 (High): separation-of-duties bypasses in evidence verification and trajectory approval (REQ-S13-012, REQ-S10-001).
  - F-DG2-142 (Medium): removing an evidence link skips the edit-rights check (REQ-S10-001).
  - F-DG2-203 (Medium): thesis sentence structure (REQ-PB-030).
  - F-DG2-204 (Medium): the charter can show a superseded North Star (REQ-PB-033).
  - F-DG2-205 (Medium): G3 can be approved before G2 (REQ-S04-005).
- REQ-S04-004 requires the G2 rejection to name the KPI, but the error points to the T02 row instead. That is close to the wording but not exact.

While I worked, the shared working tree had uncommitted changes under `apps/api/src/modules/kpi/**`, from the parallel T-DG2-KBE2 run. I didn't touch or cite them. The register should be merged into the same candidate as the T-DG2-BE3 and T-DG2-KBE2 repairs, so the round-2 reviewers check status and fixes together. Closing F-DG2-202 is for a reviewer who didn't write this change.

The handback is at `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG2/T-DG2-AN-P2-transformation-analyst.md`.
